given: Stock records exist for several different SKUs
when: The team member opens the detail view for one specific SKU
then: Only records for that SKU are shown; records belonging to other SKUs do not appear

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts that all of the selected SKU's locations are present; AC2 asserts the complement, that no other SKU's records leak in. A build could show every location of the target SKU (AC1 green) yet also list unrelated SKUs' records (AC2 red), and a build could correctly exclude other SKUs (AC2 green) while showing only one of the target SKU's locations (AC1 red).
